inputs.text: Create a retro gaming inspired T-shirt design featuring pixel art elements, neon colors, and 8-bit nostalgia. The concept is 'Level Up Your Style' with a focus on iconic gaming characters from the 80s and 90s. Design should include a dark background and vibrant neon color scheme to create an eye-catching effect. Typography should be bold and retro-inspired, complementing the overall design aesthetic.
Avoid overly complex compositions or designs that may not translate well onto a T-shirt. Minimize pixelation and ensure crisp lines for better print quality.
